source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 14: moment about B(3, -2, 3) of F = 6i + 4j - 4k acting at A, r = BA (book p.283). Answer key PDF 312: -14j - 14k.

blocks.prompt: 14. A force \(\underline{F} = 6\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\) is applied at the point \(A(1, -1, 2)\). Find the moment of the force about the point \(B(3, -2, 3)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh moment of force (force ka ghumane wala asar) ka sawal hai.
Humein \(B\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment chahiye, jo ek vector hai.
Plan: pehle \(\underline{r} = \underline{BA}\), phir determinant se \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: force \(\underline{F}\) jo point \(A(1, -1, 2)\) se guzarti hai; point \(B(3, -2, 3)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(B\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment (ghumane wala asar).
Tareeqa: Moment \(= \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) (14.3.7 (c)). Yahan \(\underline{r}\) us point \(B\) se, jis ke gird ghumana hai, force ki line wale point \(A\) tak ka vector hai. Misaal: darwaze ko qabze (hinge) ke gird ghumate hain; \(\underline{r}\) qabze se haath tak ka vector hai aur \(\underline{F}\) aap ka zor. Force components mein di hui hai, to seedha istemal hogi.

Force likhein
\[\underline{F} = 6\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Is ke components determinant ki teesri row banenge; missing component ho to wahan 0 likhna hai.

\(\underline{r} = \underline{BA}\) nikalein
\[\underline{BA} = (1 - 3)\underline{i} + (-1 - (-2))\underline{j} + (2 - 3)\underline{k}\]
\[= -2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{r}\) hamesha us point se shuru hota hai jis ke gird moment chahiye (\(B\)) aur force wale point (\(A\)) par khatam hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{r}\) ulta le lein (\(A\) se \(B\)) to moment ka sign ulta aa jayega; yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.

Determinant likhein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ -2 & 1 & -1 \\ 6 & 4 & -4 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Pehli row mein unit vectors \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\), doosri row mein pehle vector ke components \(\underline{r}\), teesri row mein doosre vector ke components \(\underline{F}\). Rows ki tarteeb wohi honi chahiye jo product ki tarteeb hai, warna jawab ka sign ulta ho jayega.

Teenon minors nikalein
\[\underline{i}\text{ minor} = (1)(-4) - (-1)(4) = 0\]
\[\underline{j}\text{ minor} = (-2)(-4) - (-1)(6) = 14\]
\[\underline{k}\text{ minor} = (-2)(4) - (1)(6) = -14\]
Kyun: Har unit vector ki row aur column ko dhak dein (cover kar dein); jo 2 by 2 bachta hai us ka (upar baayan)(neeche daayan) minus (upar daayan)(neeche baayan) minor hai. Har product ko bracket mein likhne se negative signs ki ghalti nahi hoti.

Signs \(+, -, +\) lagayein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \underline{i}(0) - \underline{j}(14) + \underline{k}(-14)\]
\[= -14\underline{j} - 14\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Determinant ko pehli row ke saath kholte waqt signs ka pattern \(+, -, +\) hota hai, yani beech wala \(\underline{j}\) ka term minus ho kar aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sab se zyada ghalti isi beech wale minus mein hoti hai; \(-\underline{j}(\text{minor})\) mein minor khud negative ho to jawab plus ban jata hai.

Moment ki miqdaar (magnitude)
\[|\underline{r} \times \underline{F}| = \sqrt{(0)^2 + (-14)^2 + (-14)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{392} = 14 \sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: Lambai batati hai ke ghumane ka asar kitna taqatwar hai; sawal ne sirf moment maanga hai, magnitude izafi maloomat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}) \cdot \underline{F} = (0)(6) + (-14)(4) + (-14)(-4)\]
\[= 0 - 56 + 56 = 0\]
Kyun: Moment \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) cross product hai, is liye \(\underline{F}\) (aur \(\underline{r}\)) dono par perpendicular hona chahiye. Dot product zero aaya, to hisaab sahi hai.
